title: Energy Consumption Analysis of Discrete Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale, their energy consumption during inference has become a critical concern. While Autoregressive (AR) models are the industry standard, Diffusion Language Models (DLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative capable of parallel token generation. In this paper, we perform a comparative energy benchmark of diffusion models (LLaDA-8B, Dream-7B) against AR counterparts (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B). We analyze the trade-offs between model architecture, KV-cache optimization, and Joules-per-token efficiency. Our results show that at longer sequences (200--600 tokens), diffusion models achieve 2.5--2.7 J/token, approximately 2$\times$ more efficient than AR models with KV-cache (5.3--5.7 J/token). KV-cache provides substantial benefits for AR models at longer sequences (50--70\% energy reduction).

translated_title: 离散扩散与自回归语言模型的能耗分析
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型规模的不断扩大，其推理过程中的能耗已成为一个关键问题。尽管自回归（AR）模型是行业标准，但扩散语言模型（DLLMs）作为一种能够并行生成词元的有前景的替代方案已经崭露头角。本文中，我们对扩散模型（LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B）与相应的自回归模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B）进行了对比能耗基准测试。我们分析了模型架构、KV缓存优化与每词元能耗效率（焦耳/词元）之间的权衡关系。结果表明，在较长序列（200–600 个词元）下，扩散模型的能耗为 2.5–2.7 焦耳/词元，比采用 KV 缓存的自回归模型（5.3–5.7 焦耳/词元）效率高约 2 倍。KV 缓存为自回归模型在较长序列下带来了显著的收益（能耗降低 50–70%）。
tldr: 本文通过对比基准测试发现，在较长序列（200–600词元）推理时，扩散语言模型的每词元能耗比使用KV缓存的自回归模型效率高约2倍，展现出显著的能效优势。
en_tdlr: Diffusion language models achieve approximately 2× better Joules-per-token efficiency than autoregressive models with KV-cache when generating longer sequences of 200–600 tokens.
